join_rule: FX closed bar may use a rate observation only if bar_close_utc >= available_at_utc. No silent forward-fill across missing observations or policy gaps.

series.publication_lag_rule: Treat as available next US business day 15:00 UTC unless ALFRED first-release proves earlier. Prefer SOFR after 2018-04-03; DFF as longer history USD proxy with explicit mapping note in any later probe.
series.fail_closed: Missing day => no carry update that day.

series.observation_clock: US Treasury published daily bill rates
series.publication_lag_rule: available_at_utc = next calendar day 00:00 UTC after observation date (conservative). Do not use same-day T-bill for Tokyo/London bars before US publish.
series.fail_closed: Missing year/day => no differential that day.

series.observation_clock: ECB deposit facility rate level series
series.publication_lag_rule: Use effective date / series timestamp; prefer official ECB SDMX daily level. available_at_utc = max(observation_date 16:00 UTC, next bar after known announcement).
series.fail_closed: Gap => hold prior known effective rate only if continuity is source-justified; else fail closed.

series.publication_lag_rule: ESTR typically T+1 morning publication. available_at_utc = next ECB business day 08:00 UTC.
series.fail_closed: Pre-2019-10-01 ESTR absent; use ECB DFR proxy only with explicit probe mapping, never silent splice.

series.publication_lag_rule: Policy rate is effective-date based; daily export repeats level. available_at_utc = observation DATE 12:00 UTC (London noon) conservative.
series.fail_closed: Missing DATE row => no GBP leg that day.

series.publication_lag_rule: Typically next London business morning. available_at_utc = next UK business day 09:00 UTC.
series.fail_closed: Missing => no SONIA differential that day.

series.observation_clock: BoJ uncollateralized overnight call average daily
series.publication_lag_rule: BoJ table updates with lag; conservative available_at_utc = next Tokyo business day 06:00 UTC. NA rows are missing, not zero.
series.fail_closed: NA or missing => no JPY money-market leg that day.

series.publication_lag_rule: Rate in force only when bar_close_utc >= effective_date 00:00 Asia/Tokyo converted to UTC. Announcement may precede effective date — never backfill future effective rate.
series.fail_closed: Sparse steps alone cannot hit 2-5 trades/week; money-market call series is required companion.

negative_control_reminder: Any later probe must include a rates-zeroed or rates-shuffled control so carry differential cannot collapse to spot momentum/rank.
